title: [finding] a seat's claim-time `Clause-②` check reads only the names a package entry re-exports, so it misses types reachable through a re-exported component's props and new i18n keys — three wrong calls in one objectui shift
body:
⛔ Not a claim. This is a handover-report item from the `domain:ui` seat 1 shift on objectui (`session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`). It is filed as a `finding` for the skills lane, as `seat-lifecycle.md`'s handover rule asks ("原则错/缺 → skills 席专题"). It is filed bare for triage to grade and route.

## The shape

At claim time, the seat decides `Clause-②: yes | no` ("does this card widen the accept set or the public surface", `execution-duties.md`). In practice the seat checked whether the card changes a name re-exported from the package entry (`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` and similar). That reading has two holes:
- a type that is **not** re-exported by name but is reachable through the prop type of a component that **is** re-exported;
- a locale pack, whose keys are a published payload and a published type.

The seat also once paired `yes` with a `patch` changeset, although `yes` takes at least `minor` (objectstack AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist item 3).

## Measured this shift (objectui, all merged)

| card | the claim said | what was true | caught by |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| objectui#11569 (PR objectui#11604) | `Clause-②: yes` with a `patch` changeset | `yes` takes at least `minor` | the at-tier contract review FAIL `5978497549`; the seat owned it in `5978504784` |
| objectui#11601 (PR objectui#11611) | `Clause-②: no`: "`WIDGETS` and `WidgetContext` are not re-exported" | `export { SchemaForm }` is in the entry, and `SchemaFormProps.widgetContext?: WidgetContext` publishes every `WidgetContext` member. The new `datasets` member is a widening, so `minor` | the dev, measured on built `dist` (`index.d.ts` → `SchemaForm.d.ts` → `widgets.d.ts`); the seat owned it in `5979387934` |
| objectui#11591 (PR objectui#11606) | `Clause-②: no`, with `@object-ui/i18n` `patch` | `@object-ui/i18n` exports `en` and `TranslationKeys = typeof en`, so a new key is a new member of a published payload and type | the at-tier review of a sibling PR (objectui#11612, HELD record on `582982e`, ②); recorded on objectui#11591 after landing |

None of the three shipped a wrong version number: the fixed group already carried pending `minor`s. What the readers get wrong is the CHANGELOG section, and the contract review skipped for `no` cards. objectui#11591's PR got no at-tier review at all.

## Why it is a principle gap, not three slips

- The criterion is stated as a question ("扩大公开面吗"). Nothing says **how** to read the public surface.
- The cheap reading (the entry's re-export names) is wrong in a way the claim cannot see.
- The `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` output says "Clause ② is NOT reachable from paths … judged from the card CONTENT", which is true but gives no instrument.
- The dev that measured it correctly used the built declaration files, the one reading that answers the question.

## Possible directions (for triage; ⛔ not a proposal this seat makes)

1. **Prose:** the claim's `Clause-②` check follows what the package's built `index.d.ts` reaches (re-exported names, plus the types of their props and parameters), and counts locale-pack keys as published.
2. **Mechanical:** a report-only script that diffs the built `.d.ts` closure of the changed packages between base and head. A dev can run it before the report; the seat cannot, since it makes no build. That would make `Clause-②` a measurement rather than a reading.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues`, scoped to objectstack-ai/objectstack.
- 「Clause-② claim judgment misses published surface prop type re-exported component i18n key changeset minor」: 8 Clause-② cards (objectstack#19548, #19532, #17800, #16931, #16229, #17213, #16949, and one unrelated). They concern carrier syntax, carrier placement and the patch-vs-minor tie-break. None concerns how the seat measures the surface. This also serves as the known-hit control: the instrument returns Clause-② cards.
- 「Clause-② published surface measurement d.ts diff dist index declaration」: 3 hits, none on point (objectstack#17723, #16229, #8075).

Dedupe words: `Clause-② published surface reachable prop type`, `claim Clause-② no wrong re-exported component`, `i18n locale key published payload Clause-②`.
